semantic_roles.background: white background with no tinted page panel
semantic_roles.contrast_and_emphasis: dark text and outlines on light fills; emphasis uses saturated categorical marks
semantic_roles.roles_and_proportions: teal Beijing, pink Tianjin, purple Hebei; pastel sector backgrounds; black outlines

marker_family.axes_and_scales: axes/scales are explicit where quantitative coordinates are present; radial geometry declares its baseline
marker_family.guides_and_grid: guides are sparse, low-contrast, and subordinate to marks
marker_family.marks_and_encoding: three radial bars per sector with variable radial extent and numeric value labels

annotations_typography.callouts_and_leaders: direct labels or compact equations stay adjacent to their marks; no decorative callouts
annotations_typography.placement_and_clearance: labels remain outside dense marks or use explicit clearance; no light text on light fills
annotations_typography.text_hierarchy: outer sector names are tangentially rotated; values are placed at bar tips; center reads Baseline

canvas_composition.alignment_and_spacing: consistent gutters and clearance around labels; no overlaps at final size
canvas_composition.aspect_and_panel_layout: single radial canvas with 12 separated sector panels and a centered baseline disc
canvas_composition.visual_hierarchy: data marks dominate; labels and legend are secondary; whitespace is intentional

chart_marks_axes.axes_and_scales: axes/scales are explicit where quantitative coordinates are present; radial geometry declares its baseline
chart_marks_axes.guides_and_grid: guides are sparse, low-contrast, and subordinate to marks
chart_marks_axes.marks_and_encoding: three radial bars per sector with variable radial extent and numeric value labels

legend_key.entries_and_encoding: one entry per semantic color/mark role
legend_key.placement: placed in the least dense whitespace region
legend_key.scope: bottom-centered three-entry legend without a frame

palette_roles.background: white background with no tinted page panel
palette_roles.contrast_and_emphasis: dark text and outlines on light fills; emphasis uses saturated categorical marks
palette_roles.roles_and_proportions: teal Beijing, pink Tianjin, purple Hebei; pastel sector backgrounds; black outlines

repetition_structures.count_spacing_rhythm: repeatable rhythm is consistent across marks
repetition_structures.grouping_and_alignment: groups align to their panel or baseline
repetition_structures.topology: 12 sectors repeat the same three-bar rhythm with varying magnitude; sector labels align to their wedge
repetition_structures.variation_and_emphasis: variation is carried by magnitude or position, not arbitrary decoration

pedagogy.when_to_use: Use for independent group magnitudes when the zero baseline is meaningful.
pedagogy.when_not_to_use: Do not use mean-only bars to hide small-n distributions or paired structure.
